name: Grand SPA Resort A-ROSA Kitzbühel
beschreibung:
Designed in the style of an alpine castle with views overlooking the famous Streif downhill course, A-ROSA Kitzbuehel welcomes discerning guests with opulent rooms, an expansive 3,000 sqm spa, and exquisite dining.

The Hahnenkamm cable car, championship golf courses, and Kitzbuehel's historic centre are only moments away.
kurzbeschreibung: Grand SPA Resort A-ROSA Kitzbuehel offers luxurious castle charm, world-class wellness, and legendary alpine vistas.
